meta.name: caveman-commit
meta.description: Ultra-compressed commit message generator. Cuts noise from commit messages while preserving intent and reasoning. Conventional Commits format. Subject ≤50 chars, body only when "why" isn't obvious. Use when user says "write a commit", "commit message", "generate commit", "/commit", or invokes /caveman-commit. Auto-triggers when staging changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把暂存变更压缩成简洁的提交信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次写提交信息都要纠结很久
copy.tagline_en: Compress staged changes into concise commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you struggle to write clear commit messages

howto.what: 装上后，当你要求生成提交信息时，Claude 会输出符合 Conventional Commits 格式的简洁提交信息：主题行≤50字符（上限72），正文只在说明“为什么”有必要时添加；它只生成文本，不执行 git 提交或暂存。
howto.when: 当你说“write a commit”、“commit message”、“/commit”等，或暂存更改时，会自动触发生成提交信息。

say.note: Claude 会按规则输出简洁的提交信息。

say.text: 给暂存的改动生成提交说明
say.note: 触发自动生成，只输出文本，不执行 git 操作。

say.text: 用 caveman-commit 写本次提交

howto.what_en: After installation, when you ask for a commit message, Claude outputs a terse, exact message in Conventional Commits format: subject ≤50 chars (hard cap 72), body only when the 'why' isn't obvious. It only generates the message, never runs git commit or stages files.
howto.when_en: When you say 'write a commit', 'commit message', '/commit', etc., or when changes are staged, it auto-triggers to generate a commit message.

say_en.text: Write a commit message for me
say_en.note: Claude will output a concise Conventional Commit.

say_en.text: Generate a commit message for staged changes

say_en.note: Invokes the skill for a terse commit message.
